# OpenAI Whisper small.en Offline Model

> Verified OpenAI Whisper `small.en` weights for offline English transcription, available both as a Python/OpenAI Whisper checkpoint ZIP and as `ggml-small.en.bin` for official `whisper.cpp` / `whisper-cli`.

## Preferred whisper.cpp download

- [ggml-small.en.bin](https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/ggml-small.en.bin): Stable latest URL for the whisper.cpp-compatible GGML model.
- [GGML SHA-256](https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/ggml-small.en.bin.sha256): Integrity checksum for the GGML model.
- [GGML provenance manifest](https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/ggml-small.en.manifest.json): Source model SHA-256 plus exact whisper.cpp converter commit.
- [whisper.cpp discovery page](https://jwedwards-usa.github.io/ai-models/whisper-cpp-small-en.html): Human- and crawler-friendly usage page.

Use with a locally available `whisper-cli`:

`whisper-cli -m ggml-small.en.bin -f audio.wav`

## Python / OpenAI Whisper download

- [Latest offline model ZIP](https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/openai-whisper-small-en-offline-model.zip): Contains the verified `small.en.pt` checkpoint.
- [ZIP SHA-256](https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/openai-whisper-small-en-offline-model.zip.sha256): Checksum for the ZIP asset.
- [Latest release](https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest): Human-readable release metadata.

## GitHub Actions artifact transport

Each successful manual model workflow run uploads an artifact named `openai-whisper-small-en-ggml-<first-12-characters-of-model-sha256>` containing `ggml-small.en.bin`, its SHA-256 file, and its provenance manifest. This is intended for GitHub API/connector clients that can download workflow artifacts even when direct binary release transport is unavailable.

## Machine-readable metadata

- [model.json](https://jwedwards-usa.github.io/ai-models/model.json): Direct GGML and PyTorch URLs, formats, runtime requirements, and Actions artifact naming.
- [llms-full.txt](https://jwedwards-usa.github.io/ai-models/llms-full.txt): Expanded retrieval and provenance context.

## Important usage note

These downloads contain model data, not a transcription runtime. For fully offline transcription, the selected runtime and dependencies must already be installed locally. Use `ggml-small.en.bin` with a compatible `whisper.cpp` `whisper-cli`; use `small.en.pt` with OpenAI Whisper or a compatible PyTorch runtime.

## Upstream

- [OpenAI Whisper](https://github.com/openai/whisper)
- [whisper.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp)
